parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific issue with enum serialization in migrations but may have unintended side effects.

issues.description: The change may introduce behavioral regressions for users who rely on the current serialization of enum values in migrations.
The PR does not include any tests to verify the fix or potential regressions.
